svg.data-weight: 9.8 kg (21.5 lbs) (guide Table 1); the data sheet says 9.52 kg (21 lbs)
svg.data-size-over-ears: 48.3 x 4.4 x 47.5 cm (19 x 1.75 x 18.7 in) with the mounting ears (guide Table 1)
svg.data-ports-max-speed: 4 ports of 400 Gbps; 8 of 200 Gbps; 16 of 100 Gbps; 32 of 50 Gbps; 8 of 40 Gbps; 72 of 25 Gbps; 72 of 10 Gbps
svg.data-power-measure: typical at 25 C ambient with 50 percent load on all ports, excluding transceivers (data sheet); the guide's Table 4 prints 190 W / 179 W
svg.data-storage-temp: -25 to 70 C (guide Table 2); the data sheet says -40 to 70 C
svg.data-optics-sfp28: 25G, 10G and 1G, in the 48 SFP25 cages (data sheet, "SFP25")
svg.data-optics-qsfp-dd: 400G, 200G, 100G and 40G with breakout, in the four QSFP-DD cages (data sheet)
svg.data-console: RJ-45 RS-232 serial on the rear, 9600 baud 8N1, no flow control
svg.data-oob: one 10/100/1000 management port on the rear
svg.data-usb: one USB port on the rear, for software or configuration updates
svg.data-certifications: BSMI, CE, KCC, NRTL, RCM, UKCA, VCCI, TEC, ANATEL, ICASA, NOM Equivalency (data sheet)

g.title: led-system

g.data-description: Table 9 - Fan Status: green all fan and power modules operating normally; amber single fan module removed or malfunctioning; red two or more fans disconnected or malfunctioning
g.title: led-fan

g.title: led-ps1
